exec: pm.test("응답 DTO와 최신순 정렬", function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array"); rows.forEach(function (book, i) { pm.expect(book).to.have.all.keys("bookId", "title", "description", "categoryName", "isAvailable"); pm.expect(book.isAvailable).to.be.a("boolean"); if (i > 0) pm.expect(rows[i-1].bookId).to.be.above(book.bookId); }); });

pm.test("등록 응답", function () { const book = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(book.title).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("runTitle")); pm.expect(book.isAvailable).to.eql(true); pm.expect(book.categoryName).to.be.a("string"); pm.collectionVariables.set("createdBookId", book.bookId); });
pm.test("검색 결과", function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(rows).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(rows[0].bookId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("createdBookId"))); });
